title: Files: tabs + grid/list
question: Which tabs + grid/list combination do you prefer?

variants.label: Browser tabs
variants.notes: Tabs always on top like a browser, path and controls under them. Grid/list toggle works (top right). Right panel switches between Details and Preview.

variants.label: Tab cards
variants.notes: Tabs as bigger cards showing folder name and full path, easier to tell apart with many open. Same grid/list toggle and Details/Preview panel.

variants.label: Tabs + split view
variants.notes: Browser tabs plus a Split view button: two folders side by side, each with its own grid/list toggle. Copy or move between panes from the action bar.
